name: Instrument Bench
prompt:
Generate ONE finished high-fidelity 1536x1024 screenshot of a proposed native Windows WinCare app. The attached image is ORIGINAL OPTION 2 Precision Console: use it ONLY for product facts, dark technical mood, readable precision and cyan family. DO NOT copy its layout. User rejected previous five concepts because they were almost the same. This new concept MUST have a substantially different silhouette, navigation, content organization and visual signature. Sophisticated character and craft; an actual useful desktop app, not a marketing website or fantasy HUD. Full window straight-on, no perspective around app, no collage. Native window controls and WinCare brand. Logical readable controls. Functional labels in Fluent icon family. High contrast. No fake machine metrics, live graphs, invented health percentages, scary alerts, success states or repair claims. First run: 'No checkup yet', 'Not checked', 'No activity yet'. Primary action 'Run checkup'. Explanation 'Collect evidence, review findings, then choose an action.' Existing modules Checkup, System care, Security, Repair & recovery, All tools, Activity, Plugin store, AI Doctor, Settings, Help must remain reachable, but reorganize their presentation.

DIRECTION A: INSTRUMENT BENCH. Character: engineered, tactile, exact. Inspired by well-made professional bench instruments and Japanese hi-fi control panels, not gaming PCs or aerospace fiction. Palette midnight graphite #131D25, blue-grey enamel #233340, muted cyan #64D7E0, pale labels #E7F1F2, tiny warm amber accents ONLY on non-status instructional marks. Solid matte materials, precise shallow bevels, strong rectangular framing, 4px corners. Condensed technical heading type, humanist body, monospace small data.
RADICALLY NEW STRUCTURE: remove the full left sidebar. Narrow horizontal top navigation tabs Home / Diagnose / Maintain / Recover / All tools; top right search icon with short search field, Activity and More. Leftmost only slim 64px utility rail with icons and labels for Plugins, AI Doctor, Settings, Help. Main canvas is one broad integrated instrument panel taking 70% height, not detached cards. Oversized left status bay titled 'CHECKUP' with calm large 'Ready when you are.' and no number; under it 'No checkup yet'. Right of status bay a crisp 2x3 bank of labeled diagnostic channels System / Security / Performance / Storage / Updates / Activity. Each channel is a solid rectangular panel with a neutral hollow status mark and 'Not checked' (Activity no activity yet), not fake dials. Separate precise vertical rail for 'Run checkup' as a substantial cyan physical-feeling button, and small explanatory caption. The signature is the purposeful diagnostic channel bank and understated instrument-like typography, not decoration. Bottom quarter is a full-width low-profile TOOL DRAWER with three horizontal tools Quick Clean, Network Tune, Startup Review and right 'Open tool' controls, followed by a slim session receipt strip 'No activity yet'. Include distinctive orderly chapter tabs and etched-looking separators without tiny unreadable texture. Show complete app. Caption 'A / INSTRUMENT BENCH / PRECISION CONSOLE STUDY'.
